newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOKYO APR-JUN HOUSING LAND PRICES FALL 0.7 PCT Q/Q.
newsitem.headline: TOKYO APR-JUN HOUSING LAND PRICES FALL 0.7 PCT Q/Q.

text.p: Residential land prices in the greater Tokyo area fell 0.7 percent in the April to June quarter compared with the previous quarter,the National Land Agency said on Thursday.
The agency said commercial land prices fell 2.5 percent from the previous quarter.
In the central Tokyo area, commercial land prices fell 2.3 percent and residential prices fell 0.7 percent.
In regional areas excepting big cities, residential land prices fell 0.3 percent and commercial land prices fell 1.7 percent from the previous quarter.
